title: CanonicalEventEnvelope
description: Standard event envelope for all Star Travels platform and Odoo integration events

event_id.description: Globally unique identifier for the event

event_type.description: Domain event type name (e.g. inquiry.created, place.published)

event_version.description: Schema version of the event payload

occurred_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the event occurred

correlation_id.description: Trace ID tracking the end-to-end request flow

causation_id.description: Event ID that triggered this event

external_id.description: Original external provider ID (e.g. Facebook message ID)

data.description: Domain-specific event payload conforming to event_type schema
